drafts.text:
@cedric_design said it right: you own the site and the domain from day one.

If you run a trade business, ask your web person one question this week. Whose name is the domain registered under? If it isn't yours or your company's, fix that first.
drafts.pattern: Blunt rule (cedric_design 1.5K, below threshold but on-brand)
drafts.video_tip: Video tip (@BourgAnthony, about 15 sec, vertical screen recording): run a public domain lookup (ICANN Lookup) on [client domain] and point at who the registrant is and when it expires. Caption: 'Do you actually own your website's domain?' Blur anything private and only show what's on screen; no made-up horror stories.
drafts.best_time_ct: Weekday late morning CT; the standing 8:54 AM slot works for one a day.

drafts.text:
You can't answer the phone with a breaker panel open. @sweatystartup shared the voicemail he used while working a day job.

Your website should do the same thing. Your name, your number at the top of every page, and when you'll call back.
